title: Premium Next-Generation Redesign Blueprint
note: Remarkable means clearer decisions, verified trust and a memorable Naxos identity—not more visual effects.

rows.Exact specification: Naxos, on your terms
rows.Implementation rule: Local certainty + premium island freedom. Avoid generic luxury language and unsupported superlatives.

rows.Exact specification: Aegean Navy #071B2A · Electric Cyan #12BCEB · Sunset Orange #FF6B35 · Limestone #F5F0E8
rows.Implementation rule: Use navy for authority, cyan for booking actions, orange only for urgency/highlights and limestone for editorial calm.

rows.Exact specification: Display: Manrope or Geist Sans 700 · Body: Inter/Geist 400–500 · Greek tested
rows.Implementation rule: H1 64/68 desktop, 40/44 mobile; body 18/30; avoid letterspaced all-caps for long labels.

rows.Exact specification: Original Naxos routes, handover moments, real fleet, people and luggage scale
rows.Implementation rule: No generic stock hero. Preferred image crops 1:1, 4:3 and 16:9; consistent vehicle angles and background.

rows.Exact specification: Phone · WhatsApp · languages · verified support hours
rows.Implementation rule: Keep compact; no duplicated nav labels.

rows.Exact specification: Logo · Cars · Locations · Naxos Guide · Help · Book
rows.Implementation rule: Single-level mobile menu; sticky Book/Check availability CTA.

rows.Exact specification: H1 + 2-line value proposition + embedded date/pickup search
rows.Implementation rule: Desktop two-column 55/45. Mobile image 42vh then four-field booking drawer. Current generic CTA is insufficient.

rows.Exact specification: Verified rating/profile · exact inclusions · secure booking · local support
rows.Implementation rule: Render only approved, attributable facts. Each proof links to its source or policy.

rows.Exact specification: Passenger · luggage · automatic · trip type → 3 recommended cars
rows.Implementation rule: Explain why each result fits; carry dates into booking.

rows.Exact specification: Port · Airport · Chora · Beach areas
rows.Implementation rule: Interactive but server-rendered text links remain crawlable.

rows.Exact specification: Real images, 6 consistent specs, live status, total-price basis
rows.Implementation rule: No mismatched model photos or generic description.

rows.Exact specification: Beach day · village loop · 3-day trip · no-car trip
rows.Implementation rule: Editorial cards answer planning intent and link to vehicle categories.

rows.Exact specification: Insurance · excess · deposit/payment · cancellation · fuel
rows.Implementation rule: Plain-language summaries link to the signed terms.

rows.Exact specification: Real source, reviewer, date and disclosure
rows.Implementation rule: Do not mark up self-serving LocalBusiness ratings for stars; never fabricate.

rows.Exact specification: Dates retained · chosen pickup · selected category · Check availability
rows.Implementation rule: Sticky mobile dock, no modal obstruction, accessible close behavior.

rows.Exact specification: Breadcrumb · category · H1 · direct answer · author/check date · hero map/photo
rows.Implementation rule: Move source/licence note below the answer, not over the hero copy.

rows.Exact specification: 3–5 key takeaways + comparison table
rows.Implementation rule: Answer-first layout for users and retrieval systems.

rows.Exact specification: Sticky TOC · scannable H2s · original photos/maps · route facts
rows.Implementation rule: One primary topic, evidence, exceptions and last-checked labels.

rows.Exact specification: Recommended vehicle logic + contextual availability search
rows.Implementation rule: Useful and restrained; do not interrupt every section.

rows.Exact specification: Gallery · model/category rule · 6 specs · dates/pickup · live total
rows.Implementation rule: Product + Car schema only; Offer only when visible and valid.

rows.Exact specification: Best for · luggage proof · route fit · included terms · alternatives
rows.Implementation rule: Use measured facts and side-by-side alternatives.

rows.Exact specification: LCP ≤2.5s · INP ≤200ms · CLS ≤0.10 at p75
rows.Implementation rule: Hero image ≤180KB AVIF/WebP, preload one hero, reserve media dimensions, third-party booking lazy until intent.

rows.Exact specification: WCAG 2.2 AA; 44px targets; visible focus; reduced motion; Greek labels
rows.Implementation rule: Contrast ≥4.5:1 body; form errors tied to fields; menu and booking usable by keyboard.

rows.Exact specification: view_vehicle · start_booking · select_pickup · quote_result · outbound_booking · whatsapp_click
rows.Implementation rule: Pass locale, source URL, vehicle/category and non-sensitive campaign context; do not send personal data to analytics.
